value.answer: Call 911 now. Fast breathing, ribs pulling in and bluish lips are emergency signs. Stay with your child and unlock the door for the paramedics.
value.triage: Call 911 now. Do not wait to see if it passes, and do not call your child's doctor's after-hours line first. If you cannot get an ambulance, go straight to the ER. Tell them: fast breathing, ribs pulling in, blue lips.
